CFML Language Reference: Functions

GetTickCount

Returns the current value of a millisecond clock. The value itself means nothing; the difference between two calls tells you how long the code in between took.

Category

System functions

Syntax

GetTickCount()

Returns

An integer number of milliseconds.

Usage

Take a reading before and after the code you want to time and subtract. For timing whole pages, turn on the execution time option on the Debugging page of the Administrator instead. CFQUERY.ExecutionTime already reports the time a query took.

Example

Opens the example in a new window. The example runs on this server, so it only works when you browse from the server itself (127.0.0.1).
<CFSET Start = GetTickCount()>
<CFSET Total = 0>
<CFLOOP INDEX="i" FROM="1" TO="20000">
  <CFSET Total = Total + i>
</CFLOOP>
<CFSET Elapsed = GetTickCount() - Start>
<CFOUTPUT>
<P>Adding up 1 to 20,000 gives #NumberFormat(Total)#.
<P>That took #Elapsed# ms. On a Pentium II/300 in 1999 you could have gone for coffee.
</CFOUTPUT>

See also

Now, GetMetricData, CreateTimeSpan
